column_description: A SERIAL primary key that uniquely identifies each vaccine detail record.
A VARCHAR(50) naming the vaccine type or variant (e.g., ‘Viral Vector’, ‘mRNA’, ‘Inactivated’, ‘Protein Subunit’).
A TEXT field describing the manufacturer or source information of the vaccine.
A VARCHAR(50) specifying the batch or lot number label.
A DATE indicating the production/manufacture date of the vaccine batch.
A DATE specifying the vaccine’s expiration date.
A BIGINT representing the quantity or measure of this vaccine lot (e.g., total units produced).
A SMALLINT counting how many vials are included in this particular batch.
A SMALLINT indicating the number of individual doses contained in each vial.
An INTEGER summing the total doses in this record (VialTally × DosePerVial).
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Shipments(ShipmentRegistry), tying this vaccine detail to a shipment.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Container(ContainRegistry), linking vaccine details to a specific container.
